name: agent-plan
description: Plan phase: the architect writes the design to a plan/<run> branch of <project>-wiki, records a build manifest (.codearmory/build.env), and opens a wiki PR for a human to review/refine and MERGE. Merging fires agent-build (the build phase).

inputs.name: repo
inputs.description: the git-factory repo the build pipeline creates/extends and opens a dev PR to

inputs.name: project
inputs.description: the project this run and every resource it creates (wiki pages, tickets, repo, PR) belong to

inputs.name: namespace
inputs.description: the git-factory namespace (owner) the repo lives under

with.run:
set -e
export HOME=/tmp
TOK=$(printf '%s' "$GIT_URL" | sed -E 's#.*//[^:/]+:([^@]+)@.*#\1#')
GF=http://codearmory-git-factory:9002
WID=$(curl -s --max-time 20 "$GF/repos" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" | tr '{' '\n' | grep "\"name\":\"${PROJECT}-wiki\"" | sed -E 's/.*"id":"([^"]+)".*/\1/' | head -1)
[ -n "$WID" ] || { echo "could not resolve ${PROJECT}-wiki repo id"; exit 1; }
echo "wiki repo id: $WID"
MF=$(printf 'TASK_B64=%s\nREPO=%s\nNAMESPACE=%s\nPROJECT=%s\n' "$(printf '%s' "$TASK" | base64 -w0)" "$REPO" "$NAMESPACE" "$PROJECT" | base64 -w0)
printf '{"ref":"plan/%s","path":".codearmory/build.env","content":"%s","message":"chore: build manifest"}' "$RUN_ID" "$MF" > /tmp/b.json
BC=$(curl -s --retry 4 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 2 -o /tmp/br -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 30 -X PUT "$GF/repos/$WID/blob" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d @/tmp/b.json)
echo "manifest blob -> $BC"; cat /tmp/br; echo
{ [ "$BC" -ge 200 ] && [ "$BC" -lt 300 ]; } || exit 1
TT=$(printf '%s' "$TASK" | head -c 60 | tr '\n"' '  ')
printf '{"source_ref":"plan/%s","target_ref":"main","title":"Plan: %s","body":"Architect plan for review. Edit the pages on the plan branch, then MERGE this PR to start the build."}' "$RUN_ID" "$TT" > /tmp/p.json
PC=$(curl -s --retry 4 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 2 -o /tmp/pr -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 30 -X POST "$GF/repos/$WID/pulls" -H "authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d @/tmp/p.json)
echo "open plan PR -> $PC"; cat /tmp/pr; echo
{ [ "$PC" -ge 200 ] && [ "$PC" -lt 300 ]; } || exit 1
PR_NUMBER=$(sed -E 's/.*"number":([0-9]+).*/\1/' /tmp/pr)
export PR_NUMBER
